title: video-move-wt: Layers never reflects selection; animate catalogue incomplete
notes: Checklist sweep gate 4 fail: all 8 steps select #clipArt while #lrArt never gets .sel, though step 1 copy says 'the row lights up in Layers' (~385). Gate 10 warn: Animate section lists Position/Scale/Opacity only; the D10 visual-clip catalogue also requires Rotation and Blur rows. Shared root cause: steps pass only a .clip id to data-select and walkthrough.js strips .sel from every .lrow, so Layers never mirrors the selection. Also D9 warn: no data-tl-summary, so the collapsed timeline row names nothing; play button lacks aria-pressed. From sweep-every-clickthrough-page-for-checklist-conf.
